messages:
emma_sales: Quick heads-up 1: Pyxis legal wants an auditable flow for the Private POC credential exchange. They asked specifically for BYOK + HSM-signed certs and short-lived keys during the 2-week trial. Can we sketch a secure, low-effort process they can approve?

raj_se: Proposal: ephemeral certs (24h TTL) + wrapped private key via customer's Vault Transit. No plaintext keys over email. CSR signed by their HSM CA.

lisa_sec: Security constraints: no long-lived plaintext keys, require HSM attestation for signing, audit trail of sign/decrypt operations, enforce TLS+mutual auth on all endpoints.

omar_it: Our infra uses Vault (transit/kv) and we can provision a transit key for wrapping. We'll need the exact commands and an ops checklist to include in our security questionnaire response.

raj_se: Draft flow (short):
1) RDW generates CSR and ephemeral key locally.
2) Submit CSR to customer HSM admin for signing; require cert TTL <= 24h.
3) Wrap private key with customer's Vault Transit key (or alternative: presigned S3 + SSE).
4) Customer returns signed cert PEM + wrapped ciphertext.
5) RDW agent consumes by calling Transit decrypt at runtime (no raw key at rest).

raj_se: Example commands (to copy/paste):
- Generate CSR: `openssl req -new -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout rdw-poc.key -out rdw-poc.csr -subj "/CN=rdw-poc-agent/O=Redwood Inference"`
- Base64 private key then wrap: `cat rdw-poc.key | base64 | jq -s -R -r @uri` then `curl -s --header "X-Vault-Token: <token>" --request POST --data '{"plaintext":"<base64>"}' https://vault.pyxis.example/v1/transit/encrypt/rdw-poc-wrap`
- Customer returns: `rdw-poc.crt` and `ciphertext` string for the wrapped key.

lisa_sec: Add security hardeners: require daily cert rotation (TTL 24h), weekly rotate the Transit wrapping key for the POC, enforce IAM restriction so only the rdw-poc-agent role may call `kms:Decrypt`/`transit:decrypt`, and enable audit logging (CloudTrail or Vault audit device) capturing all decrypt/sign requests.

raj_se: Fallback if Vault Transit unavailable: accept signed ephemeral cert + short-lived mTLS tunnel (rdw agent connects outbound to customer-approved endpoint). That needs their VPC ACL entry and an allowed CIDR block.

theo_sales_eng: Pricing blurb to include in the questionnaire response: Private POC (2 weeks) includes: one dedicated pool, HSM integration onboarding (one-time), and optional audit-log export addon. I'll add a short table of fees in the final doc.

omar_it: Technical ask: can Redwood agent auto-renew certs using a signed bootstrap token instead of manual CSR every day? Reduces ops work on our side.

raj_se: Yes. Option: initial CSR manually signed to bootstrap, then rdw agent uses a bootstrap JWT signed by customer's CA to call an internal "/sign" endpoint to renew. We only accept mTLS and signed tokens; require endpoint to support "/sign" and "/ocsp" and to revoke tokens. Document minimal API surface and token exchange flow.

emma_sales: I'll package this into their security questionnaire as a single-page flow + commands + pricing note. Omar, can you confirm Vault transit availability and provide a contact in GRC by EOD Friday?

omar_it: Will try. Security wants the draft in PDF form.

lisa_sec: For their AWS KMS policy snippet (pasteable): `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rdw-poc-agent"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"Bool":{"aws:SecureTransport":"true"}}}]}`

raj_se: Ops note: Redwood logs only non-secret identifiers (key-id hashes, cert fingerprints), never raw key material. SLA: target key replacement during POC < 30 minutes.

deploy-bot: created ticket #POC-3421 for HSM integration (assignee: raj_se, due: 2024-06-14) :white_check_mark:

emma_sales: Thanks all 1: I'll produce the questionnaire-ready PDF and attach a one-page checklist. Happy to do a 20m walk-through with Pyxis if helpful. :calendar:
